description.describe_ch: 本課程闡述貨幣與銀行對經濟體系貢獻（尤其對貨幣政策貢獻）。著重個人、企業與政府如何利用貨幣銀行體系達政策效果。配以相關時事議題深入剖析國際金融與國內金融，期達理論與實務相互配合。貨幣學方面著重貨幣創造機制及過程、貨幣理論與政策等；銀行學方面則著重金融機構與管理、商業銀行與中央銀行體系介紹等。以期末研究報告將理論與實務達相互配合之效。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces the contribution of Money and Banking to economic system It will provide students with the basic understanding of monetary economics, focus in th e creating process of deposit money, Asset & Liability management, monetary theories & policies, international banking system. Final research paper will be assigned to students during the semester. The purpose is to familiarize students with the theories & concepts learned from the class and apple them to the real world.

targets.describe_ch: 認識金融性資產及金融性資產在經濟上所扮演的功能。
targets.describe_en: To know what a financial asset is and the principal economic functions of financial assets.

targets.describe_ch: 認識什麼是金融市場及其經濟功能。
targets.describe_en: To know what a financial market is and the principal economic functions it performs.

targets.describe_ch: 使用基本經濟原理，使學生對於金融市場結構、外匯市場、金融機構管理以及貨幣政策在經濟體系中的扮演角色有通盤的瞭解。
targets.describe_en: Use the economic theory to make students full understanding about the structure of financial market, foreign exchange market, management of financial institutions, and the role of money policy in economic system.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解並說明衍生性金融商品的理論與實務。
targets.describe_en: Understand and be able to explain the theory and practice of derived financial product.
